name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Slow-Cooked Pot Roast, Mashed Potatoes & Buttermilk Biscuit
brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Slow-braised chuck roast is fork-tender with broken-down collagen fibers, served alongside creamy whipped potatoes and a warm buttermilk biscuit with zero deep-frying.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At the Plaza Inn counter, ask for the Pot Roast with mashed potatoes and a buttermilk biscuit—ask for gravy on the side and swap the green beans for extra mashed potatoes or cooked carrots.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes and biscuit contain dairy—take a lactase enzyme before eating; skip the fried onion strings on top
